crossRefs.note: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Cainan,

people.name: Enosh
people.line: Son of Seth, during whose time people called on the Lord's name.

people.name: Kenan
people.line: Son of Enosh, descendant of Seth

translations.web: Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan.
translations.bsb: When Enosh was 90 years old, he became the father of Kenan.
translations.kjv: And Enos lived ninety years, and begat Cainan:
translations.asv: And Enosh lived ninety years, and begat Kenan.
